answer: Each agent claims a dune terrace, locks a 70-credit bond, and buys a nebula seal for 30. The nebula seal binds the agent to its dune terrace; any observer proving two agents share one seal earns a 40 bounty from the burned bonds. A false claim stakes 60, forfeited when false, so bounty farming fails. The k-th seal costs 30+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,027,000 for seals and lock 70,000, vs a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 30 once, keeps its bond.
